queries.name: the envelope count falls from one to zero
queries.sql: select quantity from sql04_archive_inventory where item_id = 'ENV-TOKEN' order by event_at

queries.name: Maya holds every B-204 custody event after the signed return
queries.sql: select actor_id from sql04_badge_custody where badge_id = 'B-204' and event_at > '2026-10-16 17:24:00' order by event_at

queries.name: one amended note exists and it is Maya’s
queries.sql: select author_id from sql04_inventory_notes where note_status = 'AMENDED'
